title: An idyllic pilgrimage through the sacred valley of the Incas
text:
A lost gem within the Cusco Valley... It is the sacred valley that runs through the Urubamba Valley, through incredible landscapes, passing through Moray, historical legacy, of the engineering wonder, farmer that had the Incas, until reaching Ollataytambo an idyllic place at the foot of the temple of the sun... Memory of the past, powerful energy and sacred that had the Incas as worship to the Astro king.

 You cannot come to Peru, do the Machu Picchu, pass through Cuzco and leave aside this excursion to the sacred valley of a day or two.
It is advisable to stay in the population of ollataytam
author: veronicaeZ522RW

title: Great support and service
text: The Go Xplore agent (Humberto) was extremely helpful and took care of every issue we had during our stay; he booked all our tours and transportation and handled the tickets we needed to purchase for admission to the sites. He also gave us recommendations for restaurants in Cusco and suggested things to do in Aguas Calientes and Cusco during our stay. Great service.
author: magnogaspar
